svg.text: Building the neighbour graph: who is near whom, in PC space.
① Each cell finds its k neighbours
Distance = Euclidean, on the top PCs.
② Link every cell to its k
③ Weight links by shared neighbours
⚠️ k sets the scale. Small k → fine structure, more fragments. Large k → a smoother graph, and a group of
fewer than k cells cannot be its own neighbourhood: its members must link outside it, and it gets absorbed.
💡 Clustering (§4.2) and UMAP (§4.3) both start from this graph — not from the genes.
